title: Cumulative Update Summary for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central (December, 2025)
summary: Roundup of the December 2025 cumulative updates for Business Central, listing build numbers for BC27 CU02 (27.2, SaaS and on-premises), BC26 CU08, BC25 CU14 and BC24 CU18. It also links release plan resources and reprints Modern and Fixed Lifecycle Policy support dates for versions back to BC13.
key_points: BC27 CU02 is version 27.2: SaaS uses platform 27.0.42930.0 and on-premises uses platform 27.0.42799.0, both with application 27.2.42879
New customers start on BC27.2 automatically, while existing customers are notified by email when the update is available to them
Other December releases are 26.8, 25.14 and 24.18, with BC24 now marked end of life
Version 27.x is supported from Oct 1, 2025 to Apr 6, 2027 under the Modern Lifecycle Policy; BC14 under the Fixed Policy reached its extended end date on Oct 14, 2025
A side note recalls the earlier BC25 change extending the major update window from 30 (60) days to five months and making minor updates optional

quotes.text: New customers will automatically sign up for Business Central 2025 wave 2 (BC27.2).
quotes.why_it_matters: Shows the default enrollment strategy for new organizations and the push toward latest versions

quotes.text: Manage environment updates more flexibly - Major update: 30(60) days -> 5-month and Optional minor updates
quotes.why_it_matters: Indicates significant policy change giving customers more control over update timing and reduces forced update pressure
